reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Tom Stracuzza
reviews.text: From start to finish this was a great experience. Its a small shop with everyone being a professional. The owner was very informative and kept me updated to my car being finished. The quality of the repair along with the paint job was a solid 10. I highly recommend this shop and believe me with a son doing body estimating for over 30 years in Savannah Georgia I know what is not good and the work in this shop is great. I could not be any happier. On time and on budget. Thank You, Tom & Gerri Stracuzza

reviews.author: John McArdle
reviews.text: Great people doing fantastic work. Got hit in the back and it was stuffed in pretty good. Johnny’s did a great job and the car looks like new. They even straightened out the front fascia which wasn’t part of the accident. Highly recommend these people.

reviews.author: Jenny Wynn
reviews.text: We have used this body shop twice recently and both times have been great! We worked with Jr each time. Customer service and communication were outstanding both times. Check them out if you have any auto needs they can help with! Very pleased and will continue to use them when the need arrives.

reviews.author: Laura Olivera
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about Johnny's Body Shop I locked my keys in my car early this morning and I had to get to work and I called two tow truck companies in Rose Hill that I wont name, and none of them had time to unlock my car. I called Johnny's and they were at my house within 15 minutes and had my car unlocked 5 minutes after that they have a great price and great customer service. They are super awesome thank you so much!!! Life savers!!!!

reviews.author: Dan Strong
reviews.text: Got a tow from them when our van broke down on Highway 40. The tow truck driver was quick, friendly and extremely helpful. Definitely use them if you need a tow!

reviews.author: Mostafa Rezk
reviews.text: Excellent service and my car came out looking amazing!! Everything was really easy and effortless! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chris Sherbert
reviews.text: Amazing staff. Very helpful. Helped me when I was in a tight spot. I can't say enough about the guys.

reviews.author: Kathy Best-Newton
reviews.text: My husband and I received service on two of our vehicles. Friendly, prompt, and professional service!!
